Real-window startup trials below use standalone baseline versus Rift workspace integration build; capture correctness is valid, profile-dependent CPU/RSS is not an equivalent-build performance comparison.

A measurement-only baseline close had four pending capture jobs after 300 ms. Performance runs drain async shutdown to two seconds; all completed trials reached zero. This is not a synchronous shutdown wait in production.
